purpose: Freeze a development-only no-base float carrier-phase lane. The exact native-FGO v1 pseudorange, ordinary TDCP, position/clock motion graph, initialization, robust loss, and numeric settings are retained; only the already implemented undifferenced carrier-phase factors and per-arc float ambiguity states are enabled.

archive.selection_method: ZIP central-directory names, sizes, compressed sizes, and CRC32 only; no new member payload was opened before this freeze

truth_use_inventory.method: union of the prior authoritative inventory with the two later convergence-selector train truth reads and materialized truth members; no leaderboard score was used

split_audit.strict_definition: An identity is eligible only when absent from every known truth-use identity, every prior train/validation/holdout role, and every previously materialized truth-free candidate output; route overlap is not silently treated as new.
split_audit.blocker: The archive has only one exact route/device identity that is absent from all truth-use, prior role, and prior materialization records. Choosing three would reuse an earlier split or a sealed validation/holdout, so no train truth is opened and no validation/holdout is assigned in this phase.
split_audit.smoke_reuse_reason: These three have prior truth-free materializations only and are used solely for structural verification; they are not eligible for a new truth score or promotion gate.

algorithm_contract.baseline: exact native-FGO v1 undifferenced pseudorange + ordinary TDCP + position/clock motion with the frozen v1 initialization and parameters
algorithm_contract.candidate_delta: enable use_carrier_phase_factors and reject_rover_carrier_loss_of_lock through the existing CLI; no C++ estimator source or production default change
algorithm_contract.carrier_factor: undifferenced carrier phase in meters with a separate float ambiguity state per (SatelliteId, SignalType, continuous arc)
algorithm_contract.arc_identity: (constellation, PRN, signal); a new ambiguity state starts at first observation, non-positive time, a gap greater than max_tdcp_gap_s, ADR loss/LLI, or adapter hardware-clock discontinuity
algorithm_contract.wavelength: signalWavelengthMeters for each GPS L1 or Galileo E1 observation; invalid/non-positive wavelength is not a carrier factor
algorithm_contract.adr_contract: adapter emits carrier only for finite Android ADR with the valid state bit; E1 uses frozen Hatch-30 truth-free smoothing; reset, cycle-slip, invalid ADR, missing ADR, epoch gap, or hardware clock discontinuity starts a new arc and emits raw code for that row
algorithm_contract.clock_contract: HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount is monotonic and is checked truth-free; a discontinuity or a non-finite/common pseudorange clock-jump diagnostic fails the candidate closed
algorithm_contract.gap_contract: max_tdcp_gap_s=2.0 seconds, inherited from v1; ordinary TDCP gap and code/phase-jump rejection stay enabled
algorithm_contract.robust_loss: existing Huber loss with carrier threshold 4 sigma
algorithm_contract.float_only: fix_ambiguities=false, use_lambda_ambiguity_fix=true but no fixing is requested; fixed_solution and fixed_ambiguities must remain zero

required: finite summary, cost trace, covariance/coordinates, and keyed output
no hardware-clock discontinuity or clock jump
truth_free_structural_gate.failure_action: publish exact baseline v1 output as fallback for any route and record the reason; this phase has no promotion because the strict new split is unavailable

upstream_evidence.method_evidence: official ION abstract describes tightly coupled GNSS/INS and timestamp adjustment; official third-place abstract describes raw pseudorange, Doppler, carrier phase, and TDCP validation; these justify investigation only and are not parameter tuning evidence
upstream_evidence.local_support_decision: existing libgnss++ Eigen no-base carrier/ambiguity path is sufficient; no external source copied

commands.train_score: blocked until a new metadata-only three-identity split is available; no truth member may be opened by this freeze
